newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-HAIR-REBEL REDONDO COULD BE RECALLED BY ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAIR-REBEL REDONDO COULD BE RECALLED BY ARGENTINA.

text.p: Midfielder Fernando Redondo, who has been left in the cold by Argentina for more than two years for refusing to cut his hair, could be recalled for next month's World Cup qualifier away to Colombia.
The daily newspaper Clarin said quoted a source close to coach Daniel Passarella on Thursday as saying that the return of the talented Real Madrid player was "a concrete possibility."

Clarin's rival La Nacion claimed the Argentine Football Federation was preparing to send Real Madrid a fax "within the next few hours" announcing Redondo's selection for the match in the Caribbean port of Barranquilla on February 12.
Redondo was a key player in the Argentine team at the 1994 World Cup but has not played under Passarella, who banned long hair and ear-rings when he took over from Alfio Basile.
More recently, Passarella has claimed that Redondo has been excluded because the two cannot agree on his role in the team.
But Argentina have struggled in the World Cup qualifying group and trail group leaders Colombia, who are unbeaten, by seven points. One of their biggest problems has been a sterile midfield.

Colombia won both meetings against Argentina in the qualifiers for the 1994 World Cup, the second being an historic 5-0 triumph in Buenos Aires. The teams have met once since then, drawing 0-0 in Buenos Aires in 1995.
